title: Infection Spread Simulation I — Basic Propagation
prompt:
This is the first problem in the Infection Spread Simulation series. Use `HEALTHY = 0` and `INFECTED = 1`.

Implement `simulate_basic(grid, infection_threshold=1, directions=DIR4)`. On each day, a healthy cell becomes infected when it has at least `infection_threshold` infected neighbors in `directions`. Every transition must read the same start-of-day grid, so a cell infected today cannot transmit until tomorrow. Infection is permanent.

Return `(days_to_stability, final_grid)`. Count a day only when at least one cell changes, and stop when another update would make no changes. You may assume the grid is non-empty and rectangular, every cell is `HEALTHY` or `INFECTED`, and `infection_threshold` is a positive integer; you do not need to validate these inputs. Do not mutate the input grid.
